verse.verse_1: The excessive gathering (of increase and boasting) occupied you (from worshipping and obeying)
verse.verse_3: But no, indeed, you shall soon know.
verse.verse_4: Again, no indeed, you shall soon know.
verse.verse_5: Indeed, did you know with certain knowledge
verse.verse_6: that you shall surely see Hell?
verse.verse_7: Again, you shall surely see it with the sight of certainty.
verse.verse_8: On that Day, you shall be questioned about the pleasures.
